mapper.select: SELECT id, name, address, logo_url as logoUrl, latitude, longitude, status, phone, description, business_hours as businessHours, -- 计算距离 (单位: 米) -> 转为千米保留1位小数 ROUND(ST_Distance_Sphere( POINT(longitude, latitude), POINT(#{userLng}, #{userLat}) ) / 1000, 1) AS distanceKM FROM sys_merchant WHERE status = 1 -- 只显示营业中的店铺 ORDER BY -- 按距离升序排列 (最近的在前面) ST_Distance_Sphere( POINT(longitude, latitude), POINT(#{userLng}, #{userLat}) ) ASC
